params.body:
Saturday 07:30 to 12:00 is a regular opening line. Outside all the hours, a visit is by appointment. That is one line under the hours, not a note on Saturday (#39 made "op afspraak" the built-in Saturday note).

## What changes

- **`Pages::hoursExtra()`:** returns `siteSettings.hoursNote` (localeString) in the current language. The field is added to the Studio in ShaneDeconinck/schoutteet-sanity (branch `workbench/hours-extra-line`).
  - Without Sanity settings, it gives the built-in "Daarbuiten op afspraak".
  - Once the settings exist, Sanity's value counts, so an editor can also leave it empty and the line disappears.
- **Shown under the hours** in the footer, on the contact page and on the seller card of a vehicle page. In the footer it has a `max-w-64`, so a long text wraps instead of widening the hours column on wide screens.
- **The contact meta description** ends with it.
- **The built-in Saturday line** drops its note. The per-line `note` from #39 stays available for other uses.
- **Translations:** "Sonst nach Vereinbarung", "Otherwise by appointment", "Sinon sur rendez-vous" and "Otras horas con cita previa" replace the unused "op afspraak" keys.
- **The seed export** carries `hoursNote`.

## Checks

- `tests/Feature/OpeningHoursTest.php`:
  - The built-in line in nl and en, and in the meta description.
  - The line from Sanity in nl and fr.
  - Empty in Sanity: no line.
  - A per-line note still renders.
- Screenshots of the footer (nl, es, fr at 1440 and 390), the contact block and the seller card.
- `php artisan test`: 64 passed
- `vendor/bin/pint --test`: passed
params.title: Opening hours: one line under the hours, "Daarbuiten op afspraak"
